title: Neither the Schrödinger equation nor the wave function is fundamental

statements.text: An operator mechanics built on noncommutative Poisson, symplectic and differential structures serves as a pre-quantum algebra from which both the classical Koopman-von Neumann and the quantum wave functions follow, with no a priori Hilbert space.

sources.quote: What this suggests is that neither the Schrödinger equation nor the quantum wave function are fundamental structures
